userErrorSignals are all unresolved Sentry errors recorded for this user in the window, from any part of the product. Sign-in failures are not tagged in Sentry, so they neither prove nor rule out a failed sign-in.

question:
I need help updating Contact One’s existing CRM contact.

His company changed from Company One to Company Two. He requested that future emails go to person-2@domain-2.example.

The new email would not save. The email field became empty, so I restored person-2@domain-3.example successfully.

Please inspect why the new address won’t save and guide me through updating this same contact. His AI SDR conversation is paused and should remain paused while we resolve this.
